articles.title: Dalit Groom Dragged Off Horse, Brutally Assaulted in MP Village; Caste Slurs Alleged
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Damoh (Madhya Pradesh): In a shocking incident, a 23-year-old Dalit groom was allegedly assaulted and dragged off a horse during his pre-wedding procession in Bijori Pathak village under Hata police station limits on Tuesday evening 21 April 2026.

body.html:
Damoh (Madhya Pradesh): In a shocking incident, a 23-year-old Dalit groom was allegedly assaulted and dragged off a horse during his pre-wedding procession in Bijori Pathak village under Hata police station limits on Tuesday evening 21 April 2026.

The victim, identified as Golu Ahirwar, was participating in the traditional ‘Rachhwai’ procession ahead of his wedding in Budhi Semra village (Chhatarpur district) when the incident occurred around 5 pm.

According to police and the victim’s family, some local men allegedly objected to the groom riding a horse and began hurling caste-based abuses. When the family protested, the accused reportedly blocked the road by parking a vehicle and then attacked the procession.

Golu, who is physically challenged, was allegedly pulled down from the horse, thrown to the ground, and beaten. His sister, Manisha Ahirwar, who tried to intervene, was also assaulted. The family further alleged that some of her gold jewellery went missing during the chaos.

Eyewitness accounts suggest that the attackers clearly stated they would not allow such a procession in the area, indicating caste-based discrimination. The family has alleged that the attack was not spontaneous but driven by caste prejudice.

Following the incident, members of the Dalit community reached Hata police station and lodged a complaint. Based on this, police registered an FIR under relevant sections, including the SC/ST Act, against the accused identified as Vishwanath Lodhi, Chintu Lodhi, and others.

Hata police station in-charge Sudhir Begi confirmed the case and said efforts are underway to arrest the accused. “A case has been registered, and the accused will be apprehended soon,” he said.

Heavy police deployment was made in the village to prevent further tension, after which the wedding procession resumed. The groom and his family later proceeded to complete the wedding rituals.

Local sources indicated that similar objections to Dalit wedding processions had been reported earlier in the village as well.

#MadhyaPradesh #Damoh #DalitRights #CasteViolence #SCSTAct

articles.title: Caught on Camera: Wedding Videographer Killed in High-Speed Crash in Haryana, Driver Tried to Flee
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Sirsa (Haryana): A 22-year-old wedding videographer was killed after being hit by a speeding car while filming a bride’s farewell outside a resort on the Sirsa-Hisar Road, police said.

body.html:
Sirsa (Haryana): A 22-year-old wedding videographer was killed after being hit by a speeding car while filming a bride’s farewell outside a resort on the Sirsa-Hisar Road, police said.

The deceased, identified as Malkit alias Ajay Kumar, a resident of Abholi village in Rania, was filming a wedding ceremony early Wednesday morning near a banquet resort when the incident occurred.

According to reports and CCTV footage, Ajay was recording visuals of the bride’s farewell procession when he moved onto the road while shooting. As he stepped further onto the carriageway, a speeding Maruti Ritz coming from the opposite direction hit him with great force.

The impact was severe, throwing Ajay several feet into the air and nearly 100 feet away from the spot. He sustained critical head injuries and died on the spot.

Eyewitness visuals show chaos immediately after the collision, with bystanders rushing to help. The car reportedly lost control after the impact and hit a divider. Two occupants briefly attempted to flee the scene.

Ajay’s brother, Vishnu, who was also present and assisting with the shoot, alleged that the car was being driven at a very high speed. “I had stepped slightly onto the road but came back. My brother continued filming when the car hit him. The impact threw him far away,” he said.

Police from Civil Lines Police Station reached the spot and, with the help of CCTV footage, identified and arrested the accused driver, Sandeep, a resident of Shakti Nagar in Fatehabad. He was reportedly returning home after visiting a relative in Sirsa.

According to police officials, the driver claimed he lost control of the vehicle due to high speed. Further investigation is underway, including allegations that the driver may have been under the influence of alcohol at the time of the accident.

Ajay, who worked as a photographer, is survived by his family. His last rites have been performed, police said.

#SirsaAccident #HaryanaNews #RoadAccident #CCTVFootage #BreakingNews

articles.title: Betrayal at Its Worst: Bengaluru Gym Trainer’s Wife Elopes with His Close Friend, Refuses to Return
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bengaluru: A case of alleged elopement involving a gym trainer’s wife and his close friend has been reported from the Jayanagar police station limits, adding to a series of similar incidents in the state.

body.html:
Bengaluru: A case of alleged elopement involving a gym trainer’s wife and his close friend has been reported from the Jayanagar police station limits, adding to a series of similar incidents in the state.

The complainant, Nitesh, a gym trainer, alleged that his wife—whom he had married after a love relationship with family consent—has eloped with his friend Naveen.

According to the complaint, Nitesh and Naveen were friends while working at a private company. After the marriage, the couple reportedly stayed as tenants in Naveen’s house. During this period, Nitesh alleged that his wife developed a close relationship with Naveen and remained in constant contact with him, even saving his number under a female name to avoid suspicion.

Despite confronting the issue and later shifting to a different residence in Banashankari, Nitesh claimed that the communication between the two continued.

Three days ago, the woman reportedly took leave from work citing illness, returned home, packed her belongings, and left. Nitesh alleged that she eloped with Naveen. Following this, he filed a missing complaint at the Jayanagar Police Station.

Police traced both individuals and brought them to the station for inquiry. However, during questioning, the woman reportedly refused to return to her husband and stated that she wished to live independently in a paying guest accommodation.

Nitesh has alleged betrayal and claimed that his friend took his wife away “under the pretext of love.” He has sought action from the police.

A case has been registered, and police are continuing their investigation, including analysing call detail records (CDR) and location data to establish the sequence of events.

#Bengaluru #RelationshipDispute #ElopementCase #CrimeNews #KarnatakaPolice

articles.title: Garbage Excuse or Planned Escape? Bengaluru Woman Vanishes After Allegedly Sedating Family
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bengaluru: A woman has allegedly eloped with her lover after reportedly sedating her husband and children in a late-night incident under the jurisdiction of Bagalagunte Police Station.

body.html:
Bengaluru: A woman has allegedly eloped with her lover after reportedly sedating her husband and children in a late-night incident under the jurisdiction of Bagalagunte Police Station.

According to a complaint filed by her husband, Sharath Kumar, his wife Priyanka left their house around 11:57 pm, claiming she was going out to dispose of garbage, but never returned.

Sharath Kumar has alleged that Priyanka mixed sleeping pills into the food served to him and their two children before leaving. However, police said this claim is yet to be medically confirmed.

CCTV footage from the area reportedly shows Priyanka walking out of the house carrying a garbage bucket in one hand and a bag in the other.

Police sources said Priyanka had recently come into contact with a man identified as Prabhu, who runs a cutting shop in the locality. The acquaintance is believed to have developed into a relationship, with the two allegedly meeting when Sharath Kumar was at work.

The husband further stated that he had earlier confronted Priyanka after noticing that Prabhu was recharging her mobile phone and allegedly providing financial support, which had led to disputes between the couple.

He suspects that Priyanka may have willingly left with Prabhu. After failing to trace her, he approached the police and filed a complaint.

A case has been registered, and police are examining CCTV footage and other evidence to trace the woman and verify the allegations, including the possible involvement of the suspected acquaintance.

#Bengaluru #MissingCase #Elopement #CrimeNews #Karnataka

articles.title: Blindfolded for ‘Proposal’, Burnt Alive: Bengaluru Woman Held for Chilling Murder of Boyfriend
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bengaluru: A 27-year-old man was allegedly tied, blindfolded, and set on fire by his girlfriend in a shocking incident reported on Tuesday afternoon. Police suspect the murder was premeditated.

body.html:
Bengaluru: A 27-year-old man was allegedly tied, blindfolded, and set on fire by his girlfriend in a shocking incident reported on Tuesday afternoon. Police suspect the murder was premeditated.

The incident took place around 2 pm in Anjananagar under the jurisdiction of Byadarahalli Police Station. The victim, identified as Kiran, had reportedly visited the accused woman’s house when she was alone.

According to police, the accused, identified as Prema alias Prerna (27), allegedly told Kiran she wanted to propose to him in a “western style.” She then tied his hands and legs with a rope and blindfolded him. When Kiran questioned the restraints, she reportedly assured him it was part of the act.

Investigators said the woman later poured a flammable liquid, suspected to be kerosene, on him and set him ablaze. Kiran suffered severe burn injuries and died on the spot.

Police believe the crime may have been planned in advance, noting that the flammable substance had allegedly been arranged beforehand. Authorities are also probing claims that the accused may have recorded the incident on her mobile phone.

Both Kiran and the accused were employed at a Vi store near Bashyam Circle in Rajajinagar, where they became acquainted and later entered into a relationship. Police said the two had been in a relationship for over a year, but tensions had recently developed, with the accused reportedly upset that Kiran was distancing himself and unwilling to marry her.

On the day of the incident, Kiran had allegedly gone to pick up the woman for work related to a new Vi connection near Nelamangala. The two later went to her residence in the Gadde Khan area, where the crime occurred.

Senior police officials, including Deputy Commissioner of Police (North West) D.L. Nagesh, visited the scene. “We have taken the woman into custody. During questioning, it has been established that she set the man on fire. A murder case has been registered and further investigation is underway,” he said.

Police are now reconstructing the sequence of events to determine the exact motive and the extent of planning involved in the case.

#BengaluruCrime #MurderCase #ShockingCrime #CrimeNews #KarnatakaPolice

articles.title: Bareilly Man Who Insulted Women Walks Out Limping, Begs for Forgiveness
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bareilly: Hasan Khan, who allegedly made objectionable and abusive remarks against women in a viral social media video, was arrested by police on Tuesday, within 12 hours of the clip surfacing online.

body.html:
Bareilly: Hasan Khan, who allegedly made objectionable and abusive remarks against women in a viral social media video, was arrested by police on Tuesday, within 12 hours of the clip surfacing online.

According to police, the accused was seen leaving the police station limping after his arrest. In a video that has since emerged, he is seen crying, folding his hands, and apologising, saying, “Forgive me, a big mistake has been made. I will never do such work again.”

The controversy began on April 20 when Hasan Khan uploaded a video on Instagram. In the clip, he is seen sitting inside a car while a procession passes by, with women dancing on the road to DJ music and band-baja. During the video, he made derogatory and abusive comments about the women, which drew sharp criticism from social media users.

Police said that following the outrage, an FIR was registered and the accused was arrested within hours. During the investigation, it was revealed that Hasan Khan allegedly posed as a policeman to create a false image. He had posted multiple videos on social media wearing what appeared to be a police uniform and was also seen following a police jeep in some clips.

The accused admitted during questioning that he had purchased a police-style jacket from a shop near Chaupla and wore it to project himself as a police official. Police further stated that he used to threaten people in his locality while dressed in the uniform and was active on social media, regularly posting reels.

Officials also revealed that Hasan Khan had attended Peace Committee meetings, raising concerns over how he managed to present himself as a police-affiliated individual.

Following protests by members of Hindu organisations after the video surfaced, police took swift action. A case has been registered against the accused under Sections 79 and 205 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). He has been sent to jail, and efforts are underway to recover the fake police jacket used by him.

Izzatnagar police station in-charge Pankaj Srivastava confirmed the arrest and said further legal action is in progress.

#Bareilly #PoliceAction #ViralVideo #WomenRespect #FakePoliceman

articles.title: “Wedding Night Turns Violent” Police Lathi-Charge Baraat, Bride & Groom Taken to Station in Katni
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Katni (Madhya Pradesh): A wedding celebration in Katni district turned chaotic after police from Kuthla police station allegedly lathi-charged the baraat and family members, leaving at least 14 people injured, including women and children.

body.html:
Katni (Madhya Pradesh): A wedding celebration in Katni district turned chaotic after police from Kuthla police station allegedly lathi-charged the baraat and family members, leaving at least 14 people injured, including women and children.

The incident took place late Monday night in the Indira Nagar area. According to the victims, police first reached the procession around 1:30 a.m., when the baraat—delayed by nearly two hours due to a vehicle breakdown—was close to the bride’s house. It is alleged that police began pushing the procession without discussion, triggering an argument before leaving the spot.

Shortly afterwards, police returned with additional force and allegedly entered the wedding venue, resorting to a lathi-charge. Family members claim that women and children who intervened were also assaulted. Several people, including the bride’s brother Akash Chaudhary and the groom’s uncle, reportedly suffered fractures and serious head injuries.

Amid the chaos, the police took the bride, groom, and her brother to the police station around 2:30 a.m. They were released at approximately 4 a.m. following repeated requests, after which the wedding rituals were completed.

A video of the incident has surfaced, showing police lathi-charging the wedding party, while some attendees were seen throwing chairs. In another clip, police personnel are seen escorting the bride and groom into a vehicle, during which a pot allegedly thrown by someone hit a constable.

The injured have been identified as Sanjay Chaudhary, Manoj Kumar Chaudhary, Akash Chaudhary, Ramesh Chaudhary, Suman Bai, Rajkumar Chaudhary, Ajay Chaudhary, Bhagwati Chaudhary, Neeraj Chaudhary, Vikas Chaudhary, Sudama Chaudhary, Shubham Chaudhary, Sitaram Verma, and Shroti Verma.

On Tuesday, the victims submitted a complaint during a public hearing at the Superintendent of Police’s office. Following the incident, Additional SP Abhinav Vishwakarma placed Sub-Inspectors Siddharth Rai and Saurabh Soni on the line.

However, police have presented a different version. CSP Neha Pachisia stated that a dispute had broken out among wedding party members due to the delay, following which Dial 112 was called. She alleged that several individuals were intoxicated and began pelting stones at police when they attempted to intervene, injuring four to five personnel.

Senior officers have ordered an inquiry, and the matter remains under investigation.

#Katni #MadhyaPradesh #PoliceAction #WeddingChaos #LathiCharge

articles.title: “Stunt Gone Wrong” 11 Detained for Dangerous Jeep Ride on Bahraich Highway
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bahraich (Uttar Pradesh): Eleven individuals were detained for performing dangerous stunts while travelling in an open jeep in Bahraich district. The incident took place near Marocha Chauraha on the Bahraich–Lucknow main route.

body.html:
Bahraich (Uttar Pradesh): Eleven individuals were detained for performing dangerous stunts while travelling in an open jeep in Bahraich district. The incident took place near Marocha Chauraha on the Bahraich–Lucknow main route.

According to police, the group was spotted violating traffic norms, including overcrowding and reckless behaviour. The CO Traffic, Raj Singh, intercepted the vehicle after chase with sirens on. All 11 occupants were taken into custody, and the vehicle was seized at Fakhrpur Police Station.

Bahraich Police stated that the action was taken under the direction of the Superintendent of Police, with coordinated efforts by the CO Traffic and SHO Fakhrpur along with the police force.

Issuing a safety message, the Traffic Police emphasised that traffic rules are essential for protection and must be followed at all times. They warned that stunts, overspeeding, not wearing seatbelts, and carrying excess passengers are not just violations but serious risks that can lead to fatal consequences.

Authorities urged citizens to drive responsibly, stressing that a moment of negligence can result in lifelong regret.

#Bahraich #UPPolice #TrafficRules #RoadSafety #StuntDriving

articles.title: “Third Degree on the Street?” Haystack Arson Accused Brutally Beaten, SP Orders Probe in Anantapur
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Andhra Pradesh: A controversy has erupted in Anantapur district after a video surfaced showing alleged police brutality against a man accused of repeatedly setting fire to farmers’ haystacks.

body.html:
Andhra Pradesh: A controversy has erupted in Anantapur district after a video surfaced showing alleged police brutality against a man accused of repeatedly setting fire to farmers’ haystacks.

According to reports, the accused, identified as Sudhakar, was caught red-handed by police in Peddavaduguru mandal while allegedly attempting to set fire to haystacks. He was taken to the Peddavaduguru Police Station.

Tension escalated when locals gathered outside the police station, demanding that the accused be handed over to them. During this time, Sub-Inspector Anjaneyulu allegedly subjected Sudhakar to “third degree” treatment, beating him severely on the soles of his feet with a baton. The incident reportedly took place in public view, drawing sharp criticism.

The viral video has triggered outrage, with questions being raised over the use of excessive force and alleged double standards in police behaviour.

Responding to the controversy, Anantapur District SP P. Jagadish, IPS, has ordered a detailed inquiry by a DSP-level officer. He stated that the matter has been taken seriously and strict legal action will be initiated against those found responsible based on the inquiry report.

Further details are awaited.

#AndhraPradesh #PoliceBrutality #Anantapur #ViralVideo #LawAndOrder

articles.title: Mau Road Horror: Speeding Scorpio Hits Teen Cyclist, Leaves Him Critical; Chaos on Highway
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A serious road accident was reported on Monday afternoon on the Azamgarh–Muhammadabad Gohna main road in Uttar Pradesh’s Mau district, under the Muhammadabad Gohna police station limits.

body.html:
A serious road accident was reported on Monday afternoon on the Azamgarh–Muhammadabad Gohna main road in Uttar Pradesh’s Mau district, under the Muhammadabad Gohna police station limits.

According to reports, a speeding and allegedly out-of-control Scorpio hit a 14-year-old boy, Akash Chauhan, near Baniyapar village while he was riding a bicycle. The impact of the collision was so severe that the bicycle was completely destroyed.

Akash, son of Prakash Chauhan and a resident of Kerma Sahuawari in Azamgarh district, sustained critical injuries and was rushed by locals to a private hospital in Azamgarh, where he is currently undergoing treatment and remains in a serious condition.

Eyewitnesses said the Scorpio, which was coming from the Azamgarh side, did not stop after hitting the boy. Instead, it continued forward, crashing into a parked four-wheeler, dragging it along, and eventually ramming into an electric pole, causing further damage.

At the time of the accident, Akash was reportedly carrying mustard seeds on his bicycle to a crusher for oil extraction.

Following the incident, enraged family members and locals blocked the main road in protest. The blockade lasted for nearly an hour, leading to long traffic jams on both sides and disrupting vehicular movement. Police reached the spot after receiving information and managed to clear the road after persuading the protesters.

CCTV footage from the area has captured the entire incident. Police have initiated an investigation based on the footage and are working to identify the Scorpio driver. Officials have assured that strict action will be taken against those responsible.

The incident has sparked anger among locals, who have demanded stricter enforcement against overspeeding and reckless driving on the stretch.
